title: 100%+ short interest in GameStop stock (GME) – fundamental & technical deep value analysis
summary: Roaring Kitty's July 2020 analysis of GameStop, arguing a bullish deep-value case when the stock was about $4 and short interest exceeded 100%. It covers fundamentals, cash balance and technicals.
why: After the 2021 squeeze, HN cites it as the original thesis behind the GME story and praises its quality.

quote.text: If you haven't watched his youtube content go watch it. It's unbelievably high quality.
